chunks.content: # Aggregates & Sand
chunks.source: Geological Survey and Mines Bureau (GSMB) Sri Lanka & CIDA Specifications

metadata.title: Aggregates & Sand Guide
metadata.source: Geological Survey and Mines Bureau (GSMB) Sri Lanka & CIDA Specifications

chunks.title: Aggregates & Sand Guide
chunks.content:
Overview

Aggregates and sand constitute over 70% of concrete volume. In Sri Lanka, manufactured sand (M-sand) and river sand are used alongside crushed granite metal.
chunks.source: Geological Survey and Mines Bureau (GSMB) Sri Lanka & CIDA Specifications

metadata.title: Aggregates & Sand Guide
metadata.source: Geological Survey and Mines Bureau (GSMB) Sri Lanka & CIDA Specifications

chunks.title: Aggregates & Sand Guide
chunks.content:
Common Grades

- **River Sand / M-Sand**: Fine aggregates for mortar, plastering, and concrete mix.
- **1/2" (12.5mm) Metal**: Coarse aggregate for thin slab casting and precast elements.
- **3/4" (20mm) Metal**: Standard coarse aggregate for structural concrete foundations, beams, and columns.
- **Quarry Dust**: Base material for paving blocks and land filling.
chunks.source: Geological Survey and Mines Bureau (GSMB) Sri Lanka & CIDA Specifications

metadata.title: Aggregates & Sand Guide
metadata.source: Geological Survey and Mines Bureau (GSMB) Sri Lanka & CIDA Specifications

chunks.title: Aggregates & Sand Guide
chunks.content:
Units & Transport

- Measured in **Cubic Meters (m3)** or **Cubes** (1 Cube = 100 cubic feet = approx 2.83 m3).
- Delivered by tipper trucks.

chunks.title: Cement Products and Storage Guidelines
chunks.content: # Cement (සිමෙන්ති / Simenthi / ගබඩා)
chunks.source: Sri Lanka Institute of Architecture & CIDA Technical Standards (SLS 107)

metadata.title: Cement Products and Storage Guidelines
metadata.source: Sri Lanka Institute of Architecture & CIDA Technical Standards (SLS 107)

chunks.title: Cement Products and Storage Guidelines
chunks.content:
Overview

Cement is the fundamental hydraulic binder used in Sri Lankan masonry, concrete works, and plastering. Standard bags in Sri Lanka are distributed in 50kg bags (e.g. Tokyo Super, Sanstha, Nippon Cement).
chunks.source: Sri Lanka Institute of Architecture & CIDA Technical Standards (SLS 107)

metadata.title: Cement Products and Storage Guidelines
metadata.source: Sri Lanka Institute of Architecture & CIDA Technical Standards (SLS 107)

chunks.title: Cement Products and Storage Guidelines
chunks.content:
Common Types

- **Ordinary Portland Cement (OPC)**: High early strength, ideal for structural columns, beams, and precast concrete.
- **Portland Composite Cement (PCC)**: Blended with fly ash or slag, widely used for general masonry, block laying, and plastering.
chunks.source: Sri Lanka Institute of Architecture & CIDA Technical Standards (SLS 107)

metadata.title: Cement Products and Storage Guidelines
metadata.source: Sri Lanka Institute of Architecture & CIDA Technical Standards (SLS 107)

chunks.title: Cement Products and Storage Guidelines
chunks.content:
Typical Packaging & Units

- Standard unit: **50kg bags** or metric tons for bulk delivery.
- When buying or selling on SurplusLink, cement is specified in **bags** (e.g., 7 bags of 50kg = 350kg total).
chunks.source: Sri Lanka Institute of Architecture & CIDA Technical Standards (SLS 107)

metadata.title: Cement Products and Storage Guidelines
metadata.source: Sri Lanka Institute of Architecture & CIDA Technical Standards (SLS 107)

chunks.title: Cement Products and Storage Guidelines
chunks.content:
Buyer & Seller Considerations

- **Condition Check**: Cement bags must be sealed, free of hard lumps, and dry.
- **Shelf Life**: Unopened cement stored under dry conditions has a recommended shelf life of 3 months from manufacture date.
chunks.source: Sri Lanka Institute of Architecture & CIDA Technical Standards (SLS 107)

metadata.title: Cement Products and Storage Guidelines
metadata.source: Sri Lanka Institute of Architecture & CIDA Technical Standards (SLS 107)

chunks.title: Cement Products and Storage Guidelines
chunks.content:
Storage

- Store in a dry, enclosed shed.
- Keep bags at least 15cm off the floor on raised wooden pallets.
- Stack no more than 10 bags high to prevent compaction and bursting.
chunks.source: Sri Lanka Institute of Architecture & CIDA Technical Standards (SLS 107)

metadata.title: Cement Products and Storage Guidelines
metadata.source: Sri Lanka Institute of Architecture & CIDA Technical Standards (SLS 107)

chunks.title: Cement Products and Storage Guidelines
chunks.content:
Safety Notes

- Cement dust causes skin irritation and eye injuries. Use protective gloves and dust masks when handling.
chunks.source: Sri Lanka Institute of Architecture & CIDA Technical Standards (SLS 107)

metadata.title: Cement Products and Storage Guidelines
metadata.source: Sri Lanka Institute of Architecture & CIDA Technical Standards (SLS 107)

chunks.title: Construction Materials Overview - Sri Lanka
chunks.content: # Construction Materials Overview
chunks.source: Sri Lanka Construction Industry Guidelines & Standard Specifications (ICTAD / CIDA)

metadata.title: Construction Materials Overview - Sri Lanka
metadata.source: Sri Lanka Construction Industry Guidelines & Standard Specifications (ICTAD / CIDA)

chunks.title: Construction Materials Overview - Sri Lanka
chunks.content:
Overview

Construction in Sri Lanka relies on standard categories of materials including cement, masonry blocks, aggregates, timber, steel rebar, tiles, paint, PVC piping, and waterproofing sealants.
chunks.source: Sri Lanka Construction Industry Guidelines & Standard Specifications (ICTAD / CIDA)

metadata.title: Construction Materials Overview - Sri Lanka
metadata.source: Sri Lanka Construction Industry Guidelines & Standard Specifications (ICTAD / CIDA)

chunks.title: Construction Materials Overview - Sri Lanka
chunks.content:
Common Material Categories

1. **Structural & Masonry**: Portland cement, concrete blocks, red clay bricks, river sand, metal aggregates (1/2", 3/4").
2. **Finishes**: Wall paint (emulsion, weather shield), floor tiles (ceramic, porcelain), wall tiles, wood stain, primer.
3. **Plumbing & Piping**: PVC pipes (Type 600, Type 1000), solvent cement, ball valves, fittings.
4. **Electrical & Fixtures**: Copper cabling, switches, circuit breakers, conduit pipes.
5. **Timber & Boards**: Teak, Mahogany, Treated Rubberwood, Plywood, MDF boards.
6. **Steel & Metals**: TMT Rebar (500W grade), GI pipes, box bars, structural steel channels.
chunks.source: Sri Lanka Construction Industry Guidelines & Standard Specifications (ICTAD / CIDA)

metadata.title: Construction Materials Overview - Sri Lanka
metadata.source: Sri Lanka Construction Industry Guidelines & Standard Specifications (ICTAD / CIDA)

chunks.title: Construction Materials Overview - Sri Lanka
chunks.content:
Storage & Climate Considerations

In Sri Lanka's tropical climate (high humidity and coastal salinity):
- Cement bags must be stored indoors off concrete floors on wooden pallets.
- Rebar must be elevated and protected from rain to prevent atmospheric oxidation.
- Timber must be seasoned and kept dry to prevent warp and fungal decay.
chunks.source: Sri Lanka Construction Industry Guidelines & Standard Specifications (ICTAD / CIDA)

metadata.title: Construction Materials Overview - Sri Lanka
metadata.source: Sri Lanka Construction Industry Guidelines & Standard Specifications (ICTAD / CIDA)

- **Boxes**: Tile boxes, Screw boxes, Fitting boxes.
- **Drums**: 200L (Bitumen, Formwork oil).
- **Cartridges**: 300ml (Silicone, Mastic).

chunks.title: Paint & Surface Finishes Guide
chunks.content:
Overview

Paints and protective coatings are essential finishing materials for interior walls, exterior facades, woodwork, and metal structures in Sri Lanka.
chunks.source: Sri Lanka Coating Association & Manufacturer Guidelines (Dulux, Robbialac, Causeway)

metadata.title: Paint & Surface Finishes Guide
metadata.source: Sri Lanka Coating Association & Manufacturer Guidelines (Dulux, Robbialac, Causeway)

chunks.title: Paint & Surface Finishes Guide
chunks.content:
Common Types

- **Interior Emulsion**: Water-based paint for interior walls and ceilings.
- **Exterior Weatherproof / Weather Shield**: Acrylic-based UV and rain resistant paint for exterior surfaces.
- **Enamel Paint**: Oil-based high gloss finish for timber doors, frames, and metalwork.
- **Undercoat / Primer**: Sealer applied prior to topcoat application.
chunks.source: Sri Lanka Coating Association & Manufacturer Guidelines (Dulux, Robbialac, Causeway)

metadata.title: Paint & Surface Finishes Guide
metadata.source: Sri Lanka Coating Association & Manufacturer Guidelines (Dulux, Robbialac, Causeway)

chunks.title: Paint & Surface Finishes Guide
chunks.content:
Typical Package Units

- Standard container sizes in Sri Lanka: **1 Litre**, **4 Litres** (1 Gallon container), **10 Litres**, **20 Litres** (Bucket).
- Specify cans/buckets and size (e.g. 2 cans of 4L = 8L total).
chunks.source: Sri Lanka Coating Association & Manufacturer Guidelines (Dulux, Robbialac, Causeway)

metadata.title: Paint & Surface Finishes Guide
metadata.source: Sri Lanka Coating Association & Manufacturer Guidelines (Dulux, Robbialac, Causeway)

chunks.title: Paint & Surface Finishes Guide
chunks.content:
Buyer & Seller Considerations

- **Colour & Preference**: Colour (e.g. Brilliant White, Off White, Yellow) is a key buyer preference.
- **Storage & Seal**: Cans must be tightly sealed and stored upright away from direct heat or sunlight. Unopened cans maintain quality for 2+ years.
- **Coverage**: 1 Litre of wall emulsion typically covers 10-12 square meters per coat.
chunks.source: Sri Lanka Coating Association & Manufacturer Guidelines (Dulux, Robbialac, Causeway)

metadata.source: Sri Lanka Coating Association & Manufacturer Guidelines (Dulux, Robbialac, Causeway)

chunks.content:

chunks.title: PVC Pipes & Plumbing Guide
chunks.content:
Overview

Unplasticized Polyvinyl Chloride (uPVC) pipes are standard for cold water supply, drainage, rainwater downpipes, and electrical conduits in Sri Lankan buildings (e.g. S-lon, Anton, National PVC).
chunks.source: National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB) & SLS 147

metadata.title: PVC Pipes & Plumbing Guide
metadata.source: National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB) & SLS 147

chunks.title: PVC Pipes & Plumbing Guide
chunks.content:
Pressure Classes

- **Type 600 (Low Pressure)**: Rainwater gutters, drainage, electrical conduits.
- **Type 1000 (Medium Pressure)**: Domestic cold water distribution.
- **Type 1400 (High Pressure)**: Main pressure supply lines.
chunks.source: National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB) & SLS 147

metadata.source: National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB) & SLS 147

chunks.content:
Units & Lengths

- Standard pipe length: **4 meters** (or 6m for large main lines).

chunks.title: PVC Pipes & Plumbing Guide
chunks.content:
Storage

chunks.title: Material Reuse Guidelines
chunks.content: # Material Reuse Guidelines
chunks.source: Sri Lanka Green Building Council (GBCSL) & CIDA Reuse Standards

metadata.title: Material Reuse Guidelines
metadata.source: Sri Lanka Green Building Council (GBCSL) & CIDA Reuse Standards

chunks.title: Material Reuse Guidelines
chunks.content:
Principles of Circular Construction

1. **Reduce**: Minimize over-ordering through precise requirement planning.
2. **Reuse**: Transfer unconsumed, high-quality surplus materials from completed sites to new active projects.
3. **Recycle**: Reprocess damaged or broken brick/concrete into crushed aggregate base material.
chunks.source: Sri Lanka Green Building Council (GBCSL) & CIDA Reuse Standards

metadata.title: Material Reuse Guidelines
metadata.source: Sri Lanka Green Building Council (GBCSL) & CIDA Reuse Standards

chunks.title: Material Reuse Guidelines
chunks.content:
Material Condition Grading

- **NEW**: Unopened original packaging, recent manufacture date.
- **EXCELLENT**: Unopened or cleanly opened full containers, pristine condition.
- **GOOD**: Minor exterior package cosmetic wear, material 100% sound.
- **FAIR**: Partially used open batch or minor surface oxidation, functional for non-critical work.
- **POOR**: Heavily degraded material suitable only for landfill or scrap recovery.
chunks.source: Sri Lanka Green Building Council (GBCSL) & CIDA Reuse Standards

metadata.title: Material Reuse Guidelines
metadata.source: Sri Lanka Green Building Council (GBCSL) & CIDA Reuse Standards

chunks.title: Construction Site & Material Handling Safety
chunks.content: # Material Safety
chunks.source: Ministry of Labour & National Institute of Occupational Safety and Health (NIOSH Sri Lanka)

metadata.title: Construction Site & Material Handling Safety
metadata.source: Ministry of Labour & National Institute of Occupational Safety and Health (NIOSH Sri Lanka)

chunks.title: Construction Site & Material Handling Safety
chunks.content:
Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)

When handling surplus materials during transport, loading, or unloading:
- **Safety Boots**: Steel-toed footwear for moving heavy aggregates, rebar, or timber.
- **Heavy Gloves**: Leather/rubber gloves when moving steel bars, glass, or cement bags.
- **Dust Masks**: Respirators for handling cement, lime, dry mortar, or cutting timber/tiles.
- **Eye Protection**: Safety goggles when inspecting chemicals, solvents, or machinery.
chunks.source: Ministry of Labour & National Institute of Occupational Safety and Health (NIOSH Sri Lanka)

metadata.title: Construction Site & Material Handling Safety
metadata.source: Ministry of Labour & National Institute of Occupational Safety and Health (NIOSH Sri Lanka)

chunks.title: Construction Site & Material Handling Safety
chunks.content:
Handling Heavy Loads

- Maximum manual lifting weight per worker: 25kg. Use two-person lift or machinery for 50kg cement bags or heavy equipment.
chunks.source: Ministry of Labour & National Institute of Occupational Safety and Health (NIOSH Sri Lanka)

chunks.title: On-Site Storage & Preservation Standards
chunks.content: # Storage & Preservation
chunks.source: CIDA Site Operations Guidelines & ICTAD Manuals

metadata.title: On-Site Storage & Preservation Standards
metadata.source: CIDA Site Operations Guidelines & ICTAD Manuals

chunks.title: On-Site Storage & Preservation Standards
chunks.content:
Weather Protection in Sri Lanka

- Sri Lanka experiences heavy monsoon downpours and high humidity.
- **Cement**: Store indoors on wooden pallets, sealed from moist air.
- **Paint**: Keep in cool, shaded areas below 30°C. Never freeze or overheat.
- **Timber**: Stack horizontally with spacers (stickers) to allow air circulation.
- **Rebar**: Elevate above rain puddles; cover with breathable tarpaulins.
- **Tiles**: Keep dry to avoid carton deterioration and tile breakage.
chunks.source: CIDA Site Operations Guidelines & ICTAD Manuals

metadata.title: On-Site Storage & Preservation Standards

chunks.title: Sustainable Construction & Carbon Reduction
chunks.content: # Sustainability in Sri Lanka Construction
chunks.source: Green Building Council Sri Lanka (GBCSL) & GREEN SL Rating System

metadata.title: Sustainable Construction & Carbon Reduction
metadata.source: Green Building Council Sri Lanka (GBCSL) & GREEN SL Rating System

chunks.title: Sustainable Construction & Carbon Reduction
chunks.content:
Environmental Impact

Construction activities account for approximately 35% of industrial waste in Sri Lanka. Diverting unused surplus materials from landfills prevents embodied carbon loss and conserves virgin natural resources (e.g. river sand, timber, limestone).
chunks.source: Green Building Council Sri Lanka (GBCSL) & GREEN SL Rating System

metadata.title: Sustainable Construction & Carbon Reduction
metadata.source: Green Building Council Sri Lanka (GBCSL) & GREEN SL Rating System

chunks.title: Sustainable Construction & Carbon Reduction
chunks.content:
Green Building Rating Points

Using surplus and salvaged materials earns GREEN SL rating points under Material & Resources credits:
- **MR Credit 2**: Construction Waste Management & Diversion.
- **MR Credit 3**: Building Material Reuse.
- **MR Credit 4**: Local Material Sourcing (reducing long-distance transport emissions).
chunks.source: Green Building Council Sri Lanka (GBCSL) & GREEN SL Rating System

metadata.title: Sustainable Construction & Carbon Reduction

chunks.title: Floor & Wall Tiles Guide

Overview

Ceramic and porcelain tiles are widely used for flooring, bathroom walls, and outdoor patios in Sri Lanka.

chunks.title: Floor & Wall Tiles Guide
chunks.content:
Typical Dimensions & Packaging

- Common sizes: 300x300mm, 600x600mm, 600x1200mm, 300x600mm.
- Sold in **boxes** containing a specific coverage area in square meters (sqm) or piece count per box.

- **Shade & Batch Match**: Tiles from different manufacturing batches may have slight color shade differences. Surplus listings should state batch numbers where available.

metadata.source: Sri Lanka Tile Industry Standards (Rocell, Macktiles, Lanka Tiles)

chunks.title: Floor & Wall Tiles Guide

metadata.title: SurplusLink Buyer Guide
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Buyer Guide
chunks.content:
Overview

Buyers use SurplusLink to source construction materials, tools, and equipment efficiently across Sri Lanka.
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink Buyer Guide
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Buyer Guide
chunks.content:
Creating a Requirement

- Buyers can browse available materials on the marketplace or submit a requirement.
- When submitting a requirement, buyers specify:
  1. Material Item (e.g. Paint, Cement, Floor Tiles, Rebar).
  2. Required Quantity & Unit (e.g. 10 L, 50 bags, 100 sqm).
  3. Maximum Budget (in LKR).
  4. Preferred Condition (New, Excellent, Good, Fair).
  5. Preferences (e.g. Colour: Yellow, Brand: Tokyo Super).
  6. Delivery Location (City / District in Sri Lanka).
  7. Need-by Date / Deadline.
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink Buyer Guide
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Buyer Guide
chunks.content:
Requirement Drafts & AI Assistant

- The SurplusLink AI Assistant helps buyers create requirement drafts from natural language in English, Sinhala, Tamil, or Romanized Sinhala (e.g., "mata yellow paint 10L one Negombo walata").
- The AI creates a **Requirement Draft** for buyer review.
- The buyer must explicitly review and submit the requirement. The AI never submits requirements automatically.
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink Buyer Guide
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Buyer Guide
chunks.content:
Matching & Approval

- Once submitted, the AI Matching Engine finds single or multi-seller combinations to fulfill the requirement.
- The manager reviews recommended match groups.
- Upon manager approval, offers are created and inventory is reserved.
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink Buyer Guide
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Buyer Guide
chunks.content:
Receiving Materials

- When the seller hands over materials, the buyer inspects them and confirms receipt in the mobile app.
- Once confirmed, the transaction completes.
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink Buyer Guide
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Manager Guide
chunks.content: # Manager Guide
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink Manager Guide
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Manager Guide
chunks.content:
Overview

Managers supervise the SurplusLink ecosystem, maintaining catalog integrity, approving seller listings, validating multi-seller match allocations, and monitoring overall marketplace health.
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink Manager Guide
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Manager Guide
chunks.content:
Key Responsibilities

1. **Catalog & Template Management**:
   - Manage material categories and construction item templates.
   - Define custom seller attribute schemas (e.g. thickness, fuel type, colour).
2. **Listing Approvals**:
   - Review pending seller listings for authenticity, correct packaging specification, and fair market pricing.
   - Approve or reject seller listings with notes.
3. **Requirement Match Approvals**:
   - Review match recommendations generated by the AI matching engine for buyer requirements.
   - Verify multi-seller allocations, total fulfillment, logistics distance, and total transaction value.
   - Approve match groups to create official buyer/seller offers and reserve inventory.
4. **Transaction Supervision**:
   - Resolve disputes or non-delivery issues when handovers require manager review.
   - Finalize or release allocations if timelines expire.
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink Manager Guide
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink AI Matching Workflow
chunks.content: # AI Matching Workflow
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink AI Matching Workflow
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink AI Matching Workflow
chunks.content:
Overview

SurplusLink uses a multi-agent AI orchestration workflow to match buyer requirements with active seller listings across Sri Lanka.
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink AI Matching Workflow
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink AI Matching Workflow
chunks.content:
Workflow Phases

1. **Planner**: Parses buyer requirement details, standardizes quantities, and determines candidate filters.
2. **Item Relevance**: Strict item identity verification (e.g. Paint ≠ Bee Honey, Generator ≠ Air Compressor). Ensures items are genuinely comparable.
3. **Matching & Scoring**: Evaluates eligible active seller listings based on:
   - Available quantity
   - Material unit price
   - Condition score (New = 1.0, Excellent = 0.9, Good = 0.8, Fair = 0.6, Poor = 0.4)
   - Distance & transport cost (LKR per km)
   - Preference compatibility (Hard vs Soft preference filters)
4. **Logistics Engine**: Calculates optimal single-seller or multi-seller combinations to fulfill 100% of required quantity while minimizing total delivered cost (material + transport).
5. **Validation & Persistence**: Validates final match allocation and persists recommendation reason and score breakdown to the database.
6. **Manager Approval**: Batched match recommendations await human manager approval before reserving inventory.
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink AI Matching Workflow
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink AI Matching Workflow
chunks.content:
Score Breakdown Rules

- The match score is calculated deterministically by ASP.NET / Python matching pipeline.
- The AI Assistant explains persisted match scores and facts to users; it does NOT recalculate or invent different scores.
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink Platform Overview
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Platform Overview
chunks.content:
Overview

SurplusLink is Sri Lanka's dedicated construction material reuse and surplus marketplace. The platform connects construction contractors, suppliers, and individuals who have excess construction materials, tools, or equipment with buyers needing materials for construction projects.
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink Platform Overview
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Platform Overview
chunks.content:
Key Goals

- Reduce construction waste across Sri Lankan building sites.
- Provide affordable quality materials to buyers.
- Enable sellers to monetize unused surplus inventory.
- Automate multi-seller matching and logistics using AI optimization.
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink Platform Overview
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Platform Overview
chunks.content:
Key Roles

- **Buyer**: Requests construction materials by submitting specific project requirements (quantity, budget, preferences, location).
- **Seller**: Lists verified surplus inventory with specific packaging modes, units, pricing, and locations.
- **Manager**: Oversees marketplace integrity, approves seller listings, approves requirement matches, and monitors transactions.
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink Platform Overview
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Platform Overview
chunks.content:
Core Features

- **Dynamic Construction Catalog**: Supports materials, tools, equipment, fixtures, and temporary works with template-driven attributes.
- **Universal Quantity Model**: Handles base units (kg, L, sqm, m3, pcs) and physical package containers (cans, bags, boxes, drums) cleanly.
- **AI Matching Engine**: Evaluates item identity, quantity availability, material cost, logistics distance, transport cost, item condition, and buyer preference compatibility.
- **Grouped Manager Approval**: Multi-seller requirement matches are batched for manager verification before stock reservation.
- **Handover & Receipt Transaction Flow**: Secure milestone-based transaction lifecycle with OTP and verified receipts.
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink Platform Overview
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Quantity & Packaging Model
chunks.content: # Quantity & Packaging Model
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink Quantity & Packaging Model
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Quantity & Packaging Model
chunks.content:
Universal Quantity Concept

SurplusLink handles construction materials using a universal quantity model that distinguishes base measurements, physical packages, and package counts.
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink Quantity & Packaging Model
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Quantity & Packaging Model
chunks.content:
Key Distinctions

- **Base Measurement**: Normalized base unit quantity (e.g. Litres, Kilograms, Square Meters, Cubic Meters, Pieces).
- **Physical Package Container**: Specific physical container (e.g., Can, Bag, Box, Drum, Cartridge).
- **Package Count**: Whole integer count of physical package containers.
- **Package Size**: Volume or weight per container (e.g. 4L per can, 50kg per bag).
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink Quantity & Packaging Model
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Quantity & Packaging Model
chunks.content:
Examples

1. **Paint**:
   - 3 Cans of 4L paint = 3 Package Count × 4L Package Size = 12L Base Quantity.
   - Pricing is specified per package (LKR per can) or per base unit (LKR per L).
2. **Cement**:
   - 7 Bags of 50kg cement = 7 Package Count × 50kg Package Size = 350kg Base Quantity.
3. **Floor Tiles**:
   - 10 Boxes of 1.44 sqm tiles = 10 Package Count × 1.44 sqm = 14.4 sqm Base Quantity.
4. **Piece / Unit (Tools, Equipment)**:
   - 2 Generators = 2 Pieces / Units.
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink Quantity & Packaging Model
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Quantity & Packaging Model
chunks.content:
Overage & Minimum Package Rules

- Sellers list full physical packages. Partial physical packages (e.g. half a can of opened paint) are not sold unless listed as a custom continuous measurement.
- If a buyer requires 6L of paint and seller sells 4L cans, the buyer requires 2 full cans (8L), producing 2L of unavoidable overage.
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink Quantity & Packaging Model
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Safety & Policies
chunks.content: # Safety & Platform Policies
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink Safety & Policies
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Safety & Policies
chunks.content:
Listing Standards

- All listings must represent genuine surplus or unused construction stock, tools, or equipment.
- Hazardous chemical waste, expired structural chemicals, or prohibited substances are strictly banned.
- Sellers must accurately report condition (New, Excellent, Good, Fair, Poor).
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink Safety & Policies
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Safety & Policies
chunks.content:
Privacy & Security

- Private contact details (full names, phone numbers, exact addresses) are disclosed only between matched transaction partners after manager approval.
- AI Assistant never discloses private records of other users.
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink Safety & Policies
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Safety & Policies
chunks.content:
Quality & Verification

- Buyers are advised to inspect materials upon pickup/delivery before confirming receipt.
- Structural elements (e.g. TMT rebar, structural timber) must meet relevant Sri Lanka Standards (SLS) for reuse safety.
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Seller Guide
chunks.content: # Seller Guide
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink Seller Guide
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Seller Guide
chunks.content:
Overview

Sellers use SurplusLink to list excess or leftover construction inventory, tools, and machinery for resale to buyers across Sri Lanka.
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink Seller Guide
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Seller Guide
chunks.content:
Creating a Listing

Sellers select a catalog template or category and specify:
1. **Item Name & Category**: Select from the item catalog (e.g. Paint, Cement, Timber, Rebar, Generator).
2. **Selling Format / Quantity Mode**:
   - **PACKAGE**: Sold in containers (e.g., 4L Cans, 50kg Bags, Cartridges, Boxes).
   - **PIECE**: Sold individually (e.g., Tools, Generators, Compressors, Fixtures).
   - **CONTINUOUS_BULK**: Sold by measurement (e.g., River Sand, Aggregates, Bulk liquids).
3. **Quantity & Pricing**:
   - For package mode: Specify package container type (e.g. Can), package size (e.g. 4L), package count (e.g. 3 cans), and unit price per package container.
   - Total volume/quantity is automatically calculated (e.g., 3 cans × 4L = 12L total).
4. **Item Condition**: New, Excellent, Good, Fair, or Poor.
5. **Location & Availability**: Storage address/city and available until date.
6. **Custom Attributes**: Specific properties defined in the catalog template (e.g., Colour, Thickness, Power Rating).
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink Seller Guide
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Seller Guide
chunks.content:
Listing Verification

- Manager approves new seller listings before they become active on the public buyer marketplace.
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink Seller Guide
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Seller Guide
chunks.content:
Fulfilling Offers & Handover

- When a buyer's requirement is matched and approved, an offer is issued to the seller.
- Once accepted, the stock is reserved.
- The seller prepares materials for pickup or dispatch, updates handover status in the mobile app, and provides OTP / receipt verification to the buyer.
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink Seller Guide
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Transaction Lifecycle
chunks.content: # Transaction Lifecycle
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink Transaction Lifecycle
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Transaction Lifecycle
chunks.content:
Lifecycle States

1. **Match Recommendation**: AI engine creates match group for buyer requirement.
2. **Manager Approval**: Manager approves match group; offers are issued to seller(s).
3. **Offer Acceptance & Stock Reservation**: Seller accepts offer; inventory allocation is reserved (`RESERVED` status).
4. **Seller Handover (`Waiting for Seller` -> `Handed Over`)**: Seller prepares materials and marks handover in app.
5. **Buyer Receipt (`Waiting for Buyer` -> `Completed`)**: Buyer inspects delivered materials and confirms receipt in app.
6. **Manager Review (If applicable)**: If handover occurs without buyer receipt or timeline issues arise, transaction enters Manager Review.
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

metadata.title: SurplusLink Transaction Lifecycle
metadata.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation

chunks.title: SurplusLink Transaction Lifecycle
chunks.content:
Handover & Confirmation Security

- Transactions enforce secure verification to confirm physical exchange.
- Inventory is deducted permanently only upon successful completion.
chunks.source: SurplusLink Core Documentation
